surat.headline: Surat faces severe pre-Diwali operational and financial strain despite technical textile growth.
what_changed: Textile units face a 50% raw material cost spike and an upcoming month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers.
Power cuts of up to 8 hours and an ongoing electricity crisis are disrupting textile manufacturing and festive market operations.
Diamond sector experiences pre-Diwali financial distress, including a multi-crore default and unpaid artisan wages.
Textile manufacturers are diversifying into defence fabrics for the Indian Army and looking toward the India-New Zealand FTA.
stress_signals: A 50% spike in raw material costs is triggering a month-long loom shutdown impacting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Eight-hour power cuts and an electricity crisis are causing operational disruptions across textile units and markets [167f80ff6cdc, 5ae803461fe0].
A major diamond unit default involving crores of rupees and pending wage payments exceeding ₹20 lakh threaten worker livelihoods [8f729a2b282e, 402ab705574d].
Embroidery workers are intensifying labor agitations over long hours and lack of weekly offs, putting job-work units under stress [442c4ff911f8, a57d83616799, 29331b975c9e].
improvement_signals: Textile units have expanded into manufacturing advanced defence fabrics for the Indian Army [c4aec155608f, 4966bee026d8].
Gems exporters are working to rebuild US market business and explore new international markets [37e6ab2a18cd].
The upcoming India-New Zealand FTA is expected to enhance export opportunities for the textile sector [8e92d85d894d].
